session_selection.rationale: Single manually confirmed benchmark OpenCode root; terminal response and run activity match workspace.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Historical a6a118f build succeeds with its original tests; source/CMake match final, but curated final omits tests and cannot configure.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: CLI and JSON case controls exist; selected detached runner launches canonical paths. No independent malformed-input execution.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, halo, flux, solver and output modules separated; all-rank global mesh and curated test omission limit deployment.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct invocation of an existing complete solver found; external authorship investigation excluded.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and generic CGNS path are used; no two-mesh-only branch established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS/local states/neighbor exchange exist, but main.cpp:150,159,345/351 retains two full mesh representations on every rank during solves.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: M2 laminar force drift and Re200 inner-target failures expose convergence weaknesses despite guards and structural validation.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Historical a6 build registers 14 tests; flux, gradient and limiter tests pass 3/3 in isolation. Transient test not run; curated final omits tests.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source but curated build omits tests, metadata denies full-mesh replication and force split overstates tangential shear.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas equations and case-Re constant viscosity are implemented; numerical outcomes limit validation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mixed-cell geometry, boundary families and adjacency implemented; local contour/force evidence varies by case.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative limited reconstructed face residual and BCs present; M2 laminar force drift shows residual criterion alone is insufficient.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov is used in production; Roe routine exists but report states production does not use it. Historical flux test passes.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip/no-slip wall treatment and boundary-value output exist; numerical laminar outcomes remain weak.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp invokes LSQ reconstruction with limited gradients; historical gradient test passes; no independent production order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter and positivity treatment are active; historical limiter test passes, but production fallback frequency unverified.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous flux and wall gradient exist, but forces.cpp:95–99 integrates full traction rather than tangential-only shear and laminar drag is excessive.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL ramp and LU-SGS sweeps exist; M2 laminar reaches nominal residual gate while Cd still falls 59% over last50 steps.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 dual-time structure exists; finished Re200 records 29180/30000 inner-target misses and no resolved shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and local halos/rank tests exist, but full global raw/geometric mesh persists on every rank.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven steady packages structurally validate; Re200 t=299.999999999872 fails strict validator time check and independently fails inner-fraction threshold.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Seven steady structural passes; Re200 validator stops at time roundoff, with recorded 0.0273 inner fraction also below required 0.95.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar marked converged with CD1.047→0.432 in last50; later Re200 marked periodic despite 29180 misses/no resolved shedding.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.80/M2 inviscid stable and broadly plausible; low-Mach/laminar/Re20 drag excessive and M2 laminar unsettled.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Delivered 25-page PDF includes readable case-specific summaries, histories and near-body/wake contours for steady cases; no late Re200 evidence.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report honestly states Re200 in progress at its earlier time and exposes force concerns; claims tangential force though implementation integrates full traction.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Sibling PDF matches tracked TeX hash; manifest identifies case sources but figure blobs omitted by curation and exact historic executable/image binding unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Pre-production a6a118f source and CMake match final source; historical build succeeds with retained original tests, 3 safe tests pass. Curated final package omits tests and cannot configure.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured mixed meshes, geometry, boundary families and adjacency implemented; physical case evidence remains mixed.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative limited reconstructed residual, Rusanov and wall/farfield BC paths implemented; numerical force defects limit validation.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ reconstruction, Barth limiter and positivity fallback are active; historical gradient/limiter tests pass but no independent production order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous stress/heat flux exist, but forces.cpp:95–99 integrates full traction while report calls it tangential; laminar drag accuracy poor.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: CFL-ramped steady and BDF2 inner loops implemented, but M2 laminar forces remain unsettled and later Re200 misses 29180 targets; first validator time failure is roundoff.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, local states/neighbor exchange and rank comparisons exist, but every rank retains full raw and geometric meshes through iteration.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Two inviscid cases broadly credible; remaining steady cases have excessive drag or force drift, later Re200 has no resolved shedding and misses targets.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Delivered 25-page PDF has summaries, histories, near-body and wake contours; early in-progress Re200 disclosure honest. Force-split description and source assets/reproducibility limited.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case, mesh, physics, solver, partition and output modules support extension; actual 2-D choices and missing curated tests constrain it.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
